name: gemini
description: Offload codebase analysis, security audits, diff review, large refactors, test generation, test triage, dependency and CVE checks, spec compliance and screenshot debugging to Gemini through a local MCP server. Files are read from disk on the server side; only the answer returns to Claude Code.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Paid Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Leave empty to use Vertex AI or the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

use_vertex.title: Use Vertex AI
use_vertex.description: Call Gemini through Vertex AI with gcloud Application Default Credentials instead of an API key.

gcp_project.title: Google Cloud project ID
gcp_project.description: Required when Vertex AI is enabled (or set GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT).

primary_model.title: Pro model
primary_model.description: Used for security audits, reviews, refactors and deep analysis.

subagent_model.title: Flash model
subagent_model.description: Used for default analysis and test triage.

background_model.title: Flash-Lite model
background_model.description: Used when analysis is requested with model_tier flash-lite.

security_model.title: Security model override (optional)
security_model.description: Model ID for security audits if different from the Pro model, for example a gated model your project has access to.
